note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative (jurisdiction unspecified). The two lanes are the supplied conducts of A and of B (the affected person), drawn with identical size, colour, stroke and timing; the convergence on the event is only a supplied description. No fault, share, percentage, contributory-negligence doctrine, liability, amount or outcome is stated. Long-labels-stress: coordinator decision (standing stress-cap rule, docs/AUTHORING.md item 20; scene-area floor >= 0.20 of the frame as in accepted LAW-0701..0712). True driver: the 1:1 box. Fallbacks tried: side, split, tall (right-hand column), below, below2 and the compact-list composition (selected by scene area). Measured, rendered at 1080p (2026-10-05): six steps (three per lane) with every other field at full count → 1:1 scene area 0.137; four steps (two per lane), one account, two loss items, two notes, one labelled connector → 0.209. The stress therefore caps the step COUNT at four (baseline 2); every other count is at its maximum or above baseline and every text field keeps a near-maximum length strictly longer than the baseline.
